how_it_works.title: Our Process
how_it_works.step1_desc: Submit your case privately via our encrypted portal. Your information is protected by NDA.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Our team traces the outflow and identifies the receiving entities and exchanges.
how_it_works.step3_desc: We issue freeze requests and compel return. Funds land back in your account.
how_it_works.step4_desc: We take our 10% performance fee only after funds are  fully recovered to our system.

testimonials.title: Verified Client Stories
testimonials.client1: They recovered €82,000 from a fake investment platform in under 4 weeks. Life-changing.
testimonials.client2: I thought my money was gone forever. Veritas traced it to an exchange and froze it. Incredible.
testimonials.client3: Professional, discreet, and effective. Worth every percentage of the fee.

cta_section.title: Time is Critical
cta_section.subtitle: Cases submitted within 72 hours have a 90% higher success rate.

wizard.step1_subtitle: Enter the amount you lost and when it happened
wizard.step2_subtitle: Provide the transaction details so we can trace the funds
wizard.step3_subtitle: How were you contacted? What happened?
wizard.narrative: Brief Summary (How were you contacted? What promised returns?)
wizard.upload_hint: Screenshots, bank statements, chat logs, email headers (Max 50MB)
wizard.step4_subtitle: Review and agree to our terms
wizard.agree_terms: I acknowledge that this is a private investigation. I agree not to discuss this case publicly during the active recovery phase.
wizard.agree_fee: I agree to pay a 10% success fee solely from the recovered funds returned to my possession. I understand no fee is owed if no funds are recovered.
